title: Deep-Learning Generation of Synthetic Intermediate Projections Improves 177 Lu SPECT Images Reconstructed with Sparsely Acquired Projections.
summary: The study used 352 training, 37 validation and 15 test investigations plus phantom evaluation; image-quality and kidney-activity measures approached full-projection quality. This is a bounded imaging reconstruction result; downstream diagnostic or patient-outcome benefit is not established.
ai_technology: A 3D U-Net generated intermediate projections from sparsely acquired lutetium-177 SPECT data to improve reconstructed image quality.
